title: hex8 linear (eigenvalue) buckling analysis (engine.verify.reference_buckling)

governing_equations.name: pre-stress static solve
governing_equations.description: Reference load case solved first to recover the Gauss-point stress state.

governing_equations.name: geometric stiffness
governing_equations.description: Geometric (initial-stress) stiffness assembled from the recovered stresses.

governing_equations.name: buckling eigenproblem
governing_equations.description: Smallest positive eigenvalue lambda is the critical load factor; critical_load = lambda x applied reference load.

assumptions: Linear eigenvalue (bifurcation) buckling — no imperfections, no plasticity, no large-displacement path following.
Result is an UPPER bound on the true elastic critical load.
Isotropic homogeneous material; trilinear hex8 on a regular voxel grid.
Moment loads are not applied — C0 hex8 has no rotational DOF; the solver notes and skips them.
density_kg_m3 only needed for body loads.

boundary_conditions.fixtures: clamped/pinned/slider as in ace_fea; define the restrained support that the column/plate buckles against.
boundary_conditions.loads: the reference load case whose eigenvalue multiplier gives the critical load; a load selector catching > 30% of active elements is flagged 'suspiciously broad'.

discretization.element: trilinear hexahedron (hex8) with initial-stress geometric stiffness
discretization.notes: Square sections give a degenerate eigen-PAIR (two identical bending planes); the pin uses the smallest factor.

validation.ground_truth: Euler clamped-free (fixed-free) column Pcr = pi^2 E I / (4 L^2) = 162.85 N for L=60, b=h=6 mm, E=2.2 GPa; effective slenderness Le/r ~ 69.
validation.direction: over-predicts the critical factor (linear buckling on a stiff hex8 mesh is an upper bound); converges downward under refinement.

caveats: Linear eigenvalue buckling — no imperfections, no plasticity, no large-displacement path following; an UPPER bound on the elastic critical load.
Coarse hex8 meshes typically over-predict the factor by 10-30% (ACE's own docstring); this geometry measured better than that.
Refuses honestly when there is no compressive stress anywhere or no positive eigenvalue.

limits_of_validity.regime: slender elastic members; linear pre-buckling response
limits_of_validity.slenderness: pin measured at Le/r ~ 69; stockier columns where plasticity precedes buckling are out of scope
limits_of_validity.resolution: pin measured at voxel 1.0 and 0.5 on a 60x6x6 mm strut
